{{Short description|Japanese Mathematician and inventor of a pseudo-random number generator}}

'''Makoto Matsumoto''' (松本眞, born February 18, 1965) is a Japanese [[mathematician]] principally known as the inventor of the [[Mersenne Twister]],<ref name=mersenne-acm>{{cite journal|last1=Matsumoto|first1=Makoto E.|last2=Nishimura|first2=Takuji|title=Mersenne Twister: A 623-Dimensionally Equidistributed Uniform Pseudo-Random Number Generator|journal=ACM Transactions on Modeling and Computer Simulation|date=January 1998|volume=8|pages=3–30|doi=10.1145/272991.272995|url=https://dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.1145/272991.272995|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.asahi.com/articles/ASN614CPTN5NULBJ009.html?iref=pc_photo_gallery_bottom|title="Rebirth into another world" in the world of mathematics: A craftsman enthralled by super random numbers|website=The Asahi Shimbun|date=2 June 2020 |language=ja|access-date=2023-06-11}}</ref> a widely used [[pseudorandom number generator]].  He is also the author of the [[CryptMT]] [[stream cipher]].<ref>{{cite book |title=New Stream Cipher Designs - The eSTREAM Finalists |date=Jan 2008 |pages=7–19 |doi=10.1007/978-3-540-68351-3_2|publisher=Springer |url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/225325223}}</ref>

==Career==

In Jan 1998, while an associate professor at Keio University,<ref name=mersenne-acm /> he invented the [[Mersenne Twister]] along with [[Takuji Nishimura]]. Two years later, he completed his Ph.D.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://ci.nii.ac.jp/naid/500000213515?l=en |title=Random number generators by M-sequences with high-dimensional equidistribution property, and their dynamic creation |website=CiNii Dissertations |publisher=University of Tokyo |date=2000-03-16 |access-date=2024-06-11}}</ref> on random number generators.

Until his retirement in Aug 2023, he was a professor at the Department of Mathematics, Graduate School of Science, [[Hiroshima University]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.math.sci.hiroshima-u.ac.jp/member-all.html |title=Members of Mathematics Department |website=Hiroshima University |access-date=2024-06-11}}</ref>

==Awards==

* Kirkman Medal - 1997<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.the-ica.org/medals.php |title=ICA Medals |website=Institute of Combinatorics and its Applications |access-date=2024-06-11}}</ref>
* IBM Japan Science Prize - 1999<ref name="ibm-award">{{cite web |url=http://www-06.ibm.com/jp/company/society/science/p13th/matsumoto.html |title=IBM 科学の扉ー日本IBM科学賞ー歴代受賞者一覧 - Japan |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060517004836/http://www-06.ibm.com/jp/company/society/science/p13th/matsumoto.html |archive-date=May 17, 2006}}</ref>
* Japan Society for the Promotion of Science - 2008<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.chugoku-np.co.jp/Ad/menu/education/edu001.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220120053943/http://www.math.sci.hiroshima-u.ac.jp/m-mat/MT/chugoku-news.pdf|format=pdf|title=Chugoku News: Exploring 'Science' at Hiroshima University Graduate School of Science: High-Performance Random Number Program|website=Chugoku Shinbun|access-date=2024-06-11|archive-date=2022-01-20}}</ref>
